load_pretrained_magnet_model: load a pretrained MAGNeT model by name such as facebook/magnet-small-10secs for text-to-music generation
generate_music_from_text: generate music audio samples from text descriptions using the MAGNeT model generate method
generate_unconditional_audio: generate unconditional audio samples with no text prompt using MAGNeT generate_unconditional method
set_magnet_generation_params: set MAGNeT generation parameters like temperature top_k top_p and classifier free guidance coefficients
generate_audio_continuation: generate a continuation of an existing audio prompt using MAGNeT generate_continuation method
